cola.title: Cola can
cola.photo_alt: A red Coca-Cola can standing on a table
cola.prompt: Reconstruct the aluminum cola can in this photo. Ignore the label, condensation, table and background. Use a target height of 120 mm and a wall thickness of 0.2 mm for modeling; infer the other proportions from the photo. Preserve the cylindrical body, tapered shoulder, rolled top rim and recessed base. Make a hollow can with a closed lid. Keep unseen lid details simple.
cola.author: 些細な日常 / Nagahitoyuki
cola.postprocessing: Automatic SAM2/DA3 fitting and GPT photo-feature review; no manual geometry edits

mug.title: Ceramic mug
mug.photo_alt: A white Bovril ceramic mug with an open bowl, handle and raised foot
mug.prompt: Reconstruct the white ceramic mug in this photo, including its open bowl, curved handle and raised foot. Ignore the drink, printed logo, decorative gold lines and background. Use a target height of 100 mm and a wall thickness of 3 mm for modeling; infer the other proportions from the photo. Keep the handle opening and join both ends of the handle to the cup.
mug.author: Tangerineduel
corrections: Asymmetric handle contour, opening, rounded outer edges and attachments; cavity cut after unions.
